notes.title: Included mp3 file
notes.content:
As the game owner requested me for in-game music, I included mp3 file in the game folder.
This music was composed by using commercial licensed sound loops. Please enjoy at ease.

Right-click the game name in STEAM app.
Click "Manage".
Click "Browse Local Files".
The mp3 file is displayed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37983412/3c31f5bdd8bfee13227da3c10a5bff1af166026b.png[/img]
